title: Has any dream in the mall world came true, a.ka precog
content: I've had vivid dreams a lot, but one of the strangest I've ever had was a schoolfriend telling me he dreamed of this dream, and then him doing that in irl too. I've heard a lot of precog dreams, but that was one of the weirdest I've had, because it was two people sharing the exact same dream, and not just that, but sharing a precog dream. Sadly me and this friend had kinda gone our seprate ways, nothing bad but that sometimes just what happens in life. But anyway, I'm wondering had anyone had a mallworld dream that later came true in your own life?
